theme: Talking about your work and daily routine
title: Kazi yangu na ratiba ya kila siku
objectives: Kueleza kazi yako na majukumu yako
Kueleza ratiba yako ya kila siku kwa kutumia muda
Kutumia Present Simple kwa usahihi, hasa -s kwa he/she/it

vocabulary.example: I wake up at 5:30 every morning.
I get to work at 7 o'clock.
I help customers in the shop.
I work the night shift on Fridays.
I usually eat lunch at 1 pm.
I always check my messages in the morning.
We get our salary at the end of the month.

phrases.english: What time do you start work?
What does a normal day look like for you?
The hardest part of my job is ...
phrases.meaning: Sehemu ngumu zaidi ya kazi yangu ni ...
Baada ya kazi, kwa kawaida mimi ...

dialogue.speaker: Neema
dialogue.line: Hi Baraka! What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: I work as a cashier at a supermarket in Arusha.

dialogue.speaker: Neema
dialogue.line: What time do you start work?

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: I usually start at 8 am, but on Saturdays I start at 7.

dialogue.speaker: Neema
dialogue.line: What does a normal day look like for you?

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: I serve customers, count money and help my manager with stock.

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: Yes, very busy! The hardest part is the long queue at the end of the month.

dialogue.speaker: Neema
dialogue.line: What do you do after work?

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: I go to the gym, and sometimes I study English on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: Neema
dialogue.line: That is a good habit. My sister works at a bank. She finishes work at 5.

dialogue.speaker: Baraka
dialogue.line: Nice! Maybe she can teach me about saving money.

grammar.point: Present Simple: I work, she works
grammar.explanation: Tunatumia Present Simple kwa mambo tunayofanya kila siku au mara kwa mara. Kwa I/you/we/they kitenzi hakibadiliki: 'I work'. Kwa he/she/it tunaongeza -s au -es: 'she works', 'he goes', 'it finishes'. Kwa maswali tunatumia 'do/does': 'Do you work?', 'Does she work?'. Maneno kama always, usually, sometimes hukaa kabla ya kitenzi.
examples: She usually finishes work at 5 pm.

speaking_tasks: Eleza kazi yako kwa sentensi 3 ukitumia 'I work as...' na 'I am responsible for...'.
Eleza siku yako ya jana kuanzia unapoamka hadi unapolala, ukitumia muda (at 6 am, at noon...).
Eleza kazi ya mtu wa familia yako ukitumia he/she na -s: 'My mother sells...'.
Muulize Mwalimu maswali 3 kuhusu ratiba yake ya kila siku.
